annotationFindings.message: #@ persist source "high_value" is not a source Malloy can materialize: only a query or aggregate source builds, and a filtered pass-through, a table with only added fields, or an unbound parameterized source does not. Mark a table-shaped source `#(materialize)` instead, which stores a table-shaped source as well as a query-shaped one; or persist a query source over it, invoke a parameterized source with a bound argument, or remove the annotation
annotationFindings.subject: high_value
